notes.title: Update V.1.0
notes.content:
Hello all! The update is done. It took a while because I work alone on this project now.

-[u]Carrying items between levels[/u]
-[u]Checkpoint save system[/u]
-[u]Better updated diary for tasks[/u]
-[u]Brighter House[/u]
-[u]New jumpscares[/u]
-[u]Jumpscares Triggers Improved[/u]
-[u]Additional video settings[/u]
-[u]Better designed Menu UI[/u]
-[u]Atmospheric musics[/u]
-[u]Invert Mouse x, y axis[/u]
-[u]Running speed increased by %20[/u]
-[u]New effect[/u]
-[u]Some 3D Sounds quality improved[/u]
-[u]New Cutscenes Added[/u]
-[u]Some task order changed which are found bad by community[/u]

notes.title: Hot fix
notes.content:
Today we got some feedback about the Progress bug in the game. This bug is not occur to all players, but we made a little update about it. We are hoping this update fixes the bug.
We will do more update to improve the game.
If you have questions, please reach us on jeffanton78@gmail.com

notes.content: Incoming Evil is released! Enjoy the game.
